scope: Selected completed task outcomes, not a complete benchmark. authored counts tasks reaching the worker, not successful output. assisted includes any later model/human correction. not_run is excluded from authored.

records.description: OMEN wrote the helper on its first response, ran py_compile successfully and finished in 23.5 seconds. Codex corrected boolean context handling, preservation of extra input fields, serialization errors and literal nonempty-string handling, then integrated the offline workload comparison. Hermes independently identified the three main defects but had minor explanation errors. No second builder attempt or route activation.

Local worker wrote an unusable shortened adapter after three parse failures; Codex implemented and deployed the parser correction from the preserved baseline. No raw candidate was accepted or promoted. Offline recovery proves the first discarded response was valid JSON and preserved transport, but its parser still failed surrounding prose and its CLI argument was already corrupted upstream. Recovered output was never written by the original worker; no second builder attempt.

At the corrected 4096-token allowance, local worker wrote a complete 2525-token file in its first response. Codex corrected error propagation, missing dirty-source warning and double HTML escaping; original wording was restored after verified upstream input redaction. The raw candidate's embedded JSON round trip passed. Worker did not run a syntax check; independent execution and Hermes review are separately recorded.

Worker budget ended after four steps / 126 seconds; commit contains only retro.md and no operations_page.py at root or nested target. No Hermes review ran. Direct Codex HTML delivery is excluded from local-builder delivery counts.
